seo.title: Zayit - Jewish Study Library | Free Torah & Talmud Reader
seo.description: Zayit is a free desktop library of Jewish texts: Tanakh, Talmud, Midrash, Halacha and commentaries, with fast search and linked sources. Windows, macOS, Linux.
seo.downloadTitle: Download Zayit for Windows, macOS & Linux | Free
seo.downloadDescription: Download Zayit, the free Jewish study library, for Windows, macOS or Linux. Torah, Talmud and commentaries in one fast, searchable app. Free, with an open source core.

hero.title: Zayit
hero.subtitle: The study library that goes straight to the text
hero.description: A free app to read, search, and explore Jewish study texts. Built for study: fast search, smooth navigation, clean citations.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: Zayit is a dream turned useful: a natural, fluid, almost obvious study experience. The project will remain free by principle. Support is welcome and meaningful. It is designed to stay non-commercial. With God's help, Zayit will keep growing without losing its spirit.

spirit.title: In the spirit of a study hall
spirit.description: Zayit is designed like a digital study hall: stable, fast, consistent. You feel the calm of study: everything works, everything is in its place. The text stays at the center, with respect and without distractions.

interface.title: A pro and natural interface
interface.description: Built on JetBrains technologies, including Compose Desktop and Jewel. Inspired by Google Chrome and IntelliJ IDEA, it offers a professional interface that is fluid and natural, respects study, and does not strain the eyes.
interface.noLearning: You already know how to use it. No learning curve.
interface.navTitle: Find your way in the library
interface.navDesc: Library tree, table of contents with its own search, and a clickable book path, like IntelliJ's navigation bar

panels.title: Modular panels
panels.description: The layout adapts instantly: organize the screen the way you want. Show, hide, compare, and tailor reading to your study style.
panels.commentariesDesc: Pick your commentators and read them side by side, page after page
panels.translationsDesc: Targumim and commentaries together, around the text
panels.talmudDesc: Rashi and Tosafot beside the daf, and every verse quoted in the Gemara one click away
panels.sourcesDesc: The sources of a passage open beside it, and their book in one click
panels.detailsDesc: Author, era, edition and license of every book, at a glance

search.title: An exceptional search engine
search.description: One smart bar for everything: books, authors, references and text. Type and go straight to the right place.
search.feature1: Type a reference like "חולין יב" or "בראשית א ג" and land on it
search.feature2: Books by name or acronym, authors with their page, all from the same bar
search.feature3: Semantic search: find a passage by its meaning, not only its words
search.feature4: Even without vocalization, from a partial word or an approximate spelling
search.feature5: Clean results by category, each with its passage read in context
search.feature6: Find in the whole book, like Ctrl+F, in an instant
search.resultsDesc: The passage in its context beside the list. A click opens the book right there.
search.powered: Powered by Lucene and by Zayit's own embedding model

widgets.title: Your day, at a glance
widgets.description: Arrange your home page with widgets, the way you arrange your phone: drag them, resize them, pick them from a gallery.

companions.title: More than a library
companions.description: Zayit walks with you through the day: in prayer, in the weekly parasha, and in the lives of the sages.
companions.siddurDesc: Every day's tefilot, complete, after your nusach and your place
companions.shnayimDesc: Each verse twice, then its targum: the weekly parasha, ready to read
companions.author: Author pages
companions.authorDesc: An encyclopedia-style page for each author, with their era, names and all their books

features.title: What Zayit lets you do
features.find: Find a passage in seconds, by its words or its meaning
features.explore: Explore a library by book and table of contents
features.inbook: Search inside a book to prepare a lesson or review
features.compare: Show commentaries and translations side by side
features.tabs: Tabs, windows and virtual desktops, like Chrome: drag a tab out, pin it, find it again
features.bookmarks: Bookmarks in folders and a full visit history
features.notes: Highlight words and add your notes, right on the text
features.copy: Copy a clean excerpt with its source, or share the exact place
features.backup: Back up your notes and settings to Google Drive
features.keyboard: Made for the keyboard: Ctrl+F, Ctrl+Shift+T, Alt+Home and more
features.themes: Light and dark themes, your accent color, the fonts you like

promise.title: Our Promise
promise.speedDesc: Exceptionally fast, even on old computers. Zayit is optimized to run smoothly on any machine, so you can focus on study, not on waiting.
promise.freeDesc: Zayit is free and will remain free. Always. This is a commitment, not a marketing promise.
promise.libraryDesc: A vast library of Jewish texts at your fingertips. Torah, Talmud, Halacha, Midrash, commentaries, and much more.
promise.offlineDesc: No internet required. Once installed, Zayit works completely offline. Your study is never interrupted.

crafted.title: Crafted with care
crafted.description: Zayit aims for quality and consistency: no gimmicks, no noise. Like a digital study desk, everything is there to move forward. Every detail is designed for natural, respectful study. Built to be fast, light, almost magical, it runs even on low-powered machines.

download.title: Download Zayit
download.description: Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Free, with an open source core.

footer.license: Zayit's core is open under the Zayit Public License, based on the AGPL v3. The smart siddur and the semantic search are Zayit's own work, included free in the official builds.

dl.title: Download Zayit
dl.subtitle: The whole library on your computer. Free, with an open source core.
dl.mobile: Zayit runs on computers. Open this page on your Windows, Mac or Linux computer to install it.

offline.title: Installing on a computer without internet
offline.body: Zayit downloads its library on first launch. Without a connection, bring the app and its library with you.
offline.step1: Download the installer and every library file into the same folder (a USB key, for instance).
offline.step2: On the computer without internet, install Zayit and choose “Offline installation”.
offline.step3: Select the .part01 file: Zayit assembles the rest.

error.body: The files are also on the releases page.
